hero.title: Your storefront API, wired up in minutes
hero.lead: Products, cart, checkout, sign-in, live chat and analytics — all through one tiny JavaScript SDK. Secure by default, framework-agnostic, and live in just a few lines.

one.title: Every part of your store, one call away
one.lead: Create the client once and reach the whole storefront through clean, namespaced methods. No raw fetch, no boilerplate — and every call comes back in the same predictable shape.

secure.title: Safe to ship to every browser
secure.lead: The keys that live in the browser can't do anything dangerous — and the powerful one never leaves your server.

cards.title: Two keys, not one
cards.desc: A public key identifies the store; a publishable key is checked on every request. Copying your URL alone won't work.

cards.title: Secret key stays server-side
cards.desc: Trusted writes use a secret key you keep on your backend — never shipped to the browser.

cards.title: Sessions refresh themselves
cards.desc: Login is cookie-based; on a 401 the SDK silently refreshes and retries. You never touch tokens.

cards.title: CSRF handled for you
cards.desc: Every write is protected automatically — there's nothing to wire up.

shape.title: The same response, every time
shape.lead: Each method resolves to the same object and never throws on an HTTP error. Check ok, show error (always a ready-to-display string), use data — no try/catch gymnastics.

frameworks.title: Drop it into whatever you build with
frameworks.lead: It's plain JavaScript with zero dependencies, so it runs anywhere. The docs have a copy-paste setup for each framework.

quickstart.title: Live in under a minute
quickstart.lead: Three steps from npm install to your first call.

steps.title: Install
steps.desc: Add the SDK — or load it straight from a CDN, no bundler needed.

steps.title: Create the client
steps.desc: Two browser-safe keys, copied from your project overview.

steps.title: Call anything
steps.desc: Products, cart, checkout, auth — all there, with a uniform response.

cta.title: Build your storefront today
cta.sub: Grab your keys and make your first call in minutes. Free to start, no credit card.
